text:
Olivia: Kicking off blue/green shift for service:router-api -> v2.14.0. Change window 21:00-21:15 UTC. Planning a staged ramp: 0->5->25->60->100 by 2min checks. Canaries pinned to session-affinity off. @Jamie (SRE) can you watch router p95 and connection errors? :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/v2.14.0 -> green pool. Canary route created: router-api-canary, initial weight 0. Expected rollout plan attached. CI: green. Runbook: /docs/releases/v2.14.0

Ivan: 👍 will monitor p50/p95/p99. Setting an alert: p95 > 200ms for 3m triggers rollback-prep. Also enabling short TTL on routes (30s).

Jamie (SRE): Quick Q — are we doing session affinity off for this release? Last time it caused sticky routing during ramp.

Olivia: Yes, affinity=disabled for canary. Reason: model key cache incompatibility. We'll enable affinity after 100%.

Lee (Product): Note: this release includes prompt-fix for hallucinations. If we roll back, we need to re-pin previous model ver (model=redwood-cli:1.9.3).

Maya (Infra): I'm going to pin the old version on dedicated until rollover completes: `pin version router-api=1.9.3`

Jamie (SRE): Suggested rollback criteria: 1) p95 > 250ms sustained 3m, 2) error rate > 1% 2m, 3) token cost anomaly > +30% 5m. If any trigger, we grad-cancel to 0% and switch back to blue.

Ivan: Can we implement a soft-fail: drop to 25% if minor signal then 0% if persists?

Olivia: Yes: plan = 5% -> 25% (soft-fail) -> 60% -> 100%. If any major alarm at 25% we immediately cut to 0 and run rollback script.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout. Step 1 -> set canary=5%. Command: `deploy-bot set-weight router-api canary 5`

Jamie (SRE): Watching logs. grep for `kvcache-miss` in route logs. If we see spike, execute rollback: `deploy-bot set-weight router-api canary 0 && deploy-bot promote blue`

Ivan: Monitoring dashboard links: https://console.redwood/release/1823/dashboards/router-api p95/pipeline. Also tracing: https://jaeger/trace/abcd

Olivia: Post-deploy checklist: - confirm canary latency, - verify sessionless traffic, - run smoke prompts, - sign-off in 15m. I'll post release notes after 100%.

Lee (Product): FYI: if we need to pause, I'm OK with extending quiet-window by 30m. Notify customers via status page if >1h delay.

Jamie (SRE): Canary at 5% -> p95 120ms, errors 0.12% :thumbsup:

Ivan: After 2m, bumped to 25%.

deploy-bot: Weight updated: canary=25%.

Jamie (SRE): Observing slight increase in connection resets (from 0.01% -> 0.08%). Keeping watch, rolling-window 5m.

Olivia: If resets cross 0.2% at 25% weight, we cut to 0. Keep me posted.

Ivan: At 25% p95 140ms, resets 0.09%. Proceeding to 60% in 2m.

deploy-bot: Weight updated: canary=60%.

Jamie (SRE): Hit: token cost anomaly +35% over baseline on canary across 5m. Triggering pre-defined action.

Olivia: Rollback. Execute rollback plan now.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: setting canary=0, promoting blue back. Commands run: `deploy-bot set-weight router-api canary 0` `deploy-bot promote blue`

Ivan: Rolling back. Re-pinning to model 1.9.3 and re-enabling affinity as pre-release state. `pin version router-api=1.9.3`

Jamie (SRE): Post-rollback checks: p95 back to 110ms, errors normalized. Adding follow-up: open ticket to investigate cost increase with v2.14.0.

Olivia: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the rollback note for release notes: include timeline, triggers, mitigation, next steps. We will re-run canary after cost analysis. :writing_hand:

Lee (Product): SGTM. Please tag me in the follow-up ticket.
